audit.whatIsWrong: phases[].side was the generic 'Skill' placeholder on all 7 rows while content win[] has real verdicts (Jhin x4, Skill, Skill, Sivir) — rows 0-3 and 6 disagreed with win[].
audit.why: win[] and packet.levelChart agree and are authoritative: Jhin dominant levels 1 through 4-5, even at 6/first item, Sivir ahead at two items.
audit.corrected: Side rewritten to Jhin on rows 0-3 and Sivir on row 6. Rows 4 and 5 were already 'Skill' matching win[], so only their .why text (which had been arguing a pro-Jhin verdict) was rewritten to be even; row 6's .why was rewritten to argue Sivir's favor.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[0].text has a garbled leftover: 'Deadly Flourish (W... actually Q auto) fourth-shot crit' misidentifies Dancing Grenade as W and contradicts itself on which ability it's naming.
audit.why: Dancing Grenade is Jhin's Q; the fourth-shot crit comes from his passive Whisper on the reset auto, not from W (Deadly Flourish, his root).
audit.corrected: Rewrote the sentence to correctly attribute Dancing Grenade to Q and the fourth-shot crit to the auto/passive, removing the self-contradicting parenthetical.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns has no cooldown number (lint COOLDOWN_NO_DIGIT), and multiple fields misgender Sivir as he/his/him.
audit.why: Spell Shield (E) is 24s at rank 1, down to 18s maxed — the number that governs when it's safe to commit. Sivir is she/her.
audit.corrected: Cooldowns rewritten with real numbers; he/his/him -> she/her fixed across tldr, tradeGood, phases, breakdown.trading, dosFull, dontsFull, report; copy-paste-bled dosFull[1].d and dontsFull[2].d replaced with content matching their titles.
